item.title: Mouse without borders says keys dont match, when it does
item.author: Jebarson

judgment.rationale: Mouse Without Borders InvalidKey occurs while machines are on mismatched PowerToys versions and one commenter fixed a similar failure by updating/reinstalling, so same-version evidence is needed before a code fix.
evidence: Reporter has one device on 0.101.2362.0 and another on 0.100.0.0 after restoring backup from the older machine.
Another user with version mismatch reported it worked after installing/updating.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask the reporter to align both machines to the same current build, regenerate/copy the key, and provide paired diagnostics only if it still fails.

fix_assessment.rationale: Current evidence points first to version/config mismatch or stale restored state, not a confirmed code defect.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Without Borders reports keys do not match while devices are on different PowerToys versions and one was restored from another machine backup.
known_information: Reporter copied/pasted the key but still saw mismatch.
inferences: Protocol/config changes or stale restored identity material may explain the mismatch.
issue_context.analysis: The next useful evidence is a same-version repro with regenerated keys.
initial_investigation: Similar search found no stronger duplicate/fix beyond this issue.

information_gaps.information: Whether InvalidKey persists after both machines run the same current build and keys are regenerated.
information_gaps.why_needed: Separates expected mismatch/stale config from current Mouse Without Borders validation bug.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Update both machines, regenerate/copy key, retry, then comment /bugreport from both machines if it still fails.

actions.label: Confirm same-version Mouse Without Borders repro

comment.body: The current report shows the two machines are on different PowerToys versions (`0.100.0.0` and `0.101.2362.0`) and one was restored from backup. Please update both machines to the same latest PowerToys build, regenerate/copy the Mouse Without Borders key again, and retry. If it still reports `InvalidKey`, add `/bugreport` from both machines right after the failed connection attempt.
